gloss_en: Chovlim ("Destroyers/Wounders") — the staff named in Zechariah 11:7 ("one I called Pleasantness and one I called Chovlim"), interpreted per Sanhedrin 24a as the Torah scholars outside the Land of Israel who wound each other in halakhic debate; in Likutey Moharan II:71 it designates the mochin (mentalities) of outside the Land, opposite the mochin of the Land of Israel which are No'am (Pleasantness). Distinct from חֲבָלִים (ropes/pangs) and from חוֹבְלִים as sailors (רַב הַחוֹבֵל).
